subject: Private deployment identity readiness: on-call handshake and provisioning checklist
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@clearhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearhealth.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private deploy identity handoff: SAML/SCIM + role mapping readiness

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're starting the dry-run for our private control plane deployment in our us-west VPC next week and need to confirm the identity handoff details so we don't hit a gap during the cutover.

High level asks from our security team:
- Confirm the SAML metadata you expect from our IdP and any required entity attributes (NameID format, assertion consumer URL, signing digest).
- Confirm SCIM schema and whether you support bulk user imports vs incremental provisioning.
- Provide the mapping table you use to translate SCIM groups -> Redwood IAM roles during onboarding.
- Verify which network egress/IPs your control plane will use for SAML/SCIM callbacks so we can whitelist.

I've looped in our IdP vendor (Anil) and our security inbox. We can provide sample metadata and a short window where we can flip assertions to your staging control plane for a smoke test.

Can we do a 30-min readiness call tomorrow (Tue) at 11am PT? If that works, please reply with who from your side should be on the call and any pre-reads.

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Security Lead, ClearHealth
priya@clearhealth.com

Attachments: saml-metadata-clearhealth.xml (stub), scim-schema-v2-snapshot.json (stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@clearhealth.com>, Anil Kapoor <anil@idpbridge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deploy identity handoff: SAML/SCIM + role mapping readiness

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear checklist. 11am PT tomorrow works for our team. For the call we'll have: Marcus (identity integration owner), Dev (private CP runtime/network owner), and me (program lead).

Pre-reads we need from you (if possible):
- SAML metadata (your signed metadata file) and the Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL you plan to use for staging.
- SCIM provisioning logs or a sample CSV of users you expect to seed (helps us validate attribute mappings).
- A short list of the groups you want mapped to admin/observer/dev roles.

From our side, we'll share:
- A draft id-mapping-table.csv (attached) that shows the SCIM group -> Redwood role logic we normally apply (can be adjusted during the call).
- IP ranges and FQDNs we use for control plane callbacks and health checks (we'll paste the CIDR list in chat).

I'll attach the draft mapping and a quick diagram of the control-plane endpoints. Looking forward to the call.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference
Attachments: id-mapping-table.csv (stub), network-access-matrix.png (stub)

From: Anil Kapoor <anil@idpbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya@clearhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deploy identity handoff: SAML/SCIM + role mapping readiness

Thanks Hannah/Priya — I'm Anil from IdPBridge, happy to help with metadata and assertion testing. A couple notes from the IdP side before the call:
- We will send signed metadata in the exact W3C SAML metadata format; our default NameID is transient but we can switch to emailAddress/persistent per request.
- We support SCIM 2.0 push provisioning and can do bulk imports via our admin API (rate-limited).
- For group syncing, we can namespace groups (e.g., RH_admins) to make mappings explicit.

I'll prepare two artifacts for tomorrow: a signed metadata XML and a sample SCIM export with ~50 users.

-Anil
Anil Kapoor
Systems Engineer, IdPBridge
anil@idpbridge.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@clearhealth.com>, Anil Kapoor <anil@idpbridge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deploy identity handoff: SAML/SCIM + role mapping readiness

Thanks for the quick call today — notes and action items below. Sending this as a thread summary so we have the checklist in one place.

Call summary (11/3/2026):
- Verified SAML metadata exchange and NameID preferences (ClearHealth will send persistent NameID with emailAddress format).
- Agreed SAML assertion attributes required: email (primary), given_name, family_name, groups (multi-valued).
- SCIM: IdPBridge confirmed incremental provisioning via SCIM 2.0 PATCH is available; bulk seeding via the admin export is OK for initial sync.
- Mapping: we walked through the draft id-mapping-table.csv and suggested two changes (see row comments).
- Network: Redwood staging control plane egress IPs: 3.14.50.0/24, 34.21.12.0/24 — Priya to request whitelist for callbacks and health checks.

Action items (owner — due):
- ClearHealth: provision staging metadata and send signed file to hannah_schmitt@redwood.com by 2026-11-04 09:00 PT (Priya).
- IdPBridge: provide SCIM export CSV (~50 users) by 2026-11-04 EOD (Anil).
- Redwood (Marcus): finalize mapping table adjustments and return updated CSV by 2026-11-04 12:00 PT.
- Redwood (Dev): confirm firewall/callback ports (HTTPS 443) and post the final CIDR allowlist to the shared Drive folder (by 2026-11-04 EOD).

Next step: smoke test window — Nov 5, 2026 08:30–10:30 PT. During the window we'll flip assertions to staging and exercise a create/update/delete user cycle and group->role assignment. If smoke passes, we schedule the production cutover.

I'll attach the call recording link and updated mapping (once Marcus edits).

Hannah

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya@clearhealth.com>, Anil Kapoor <anil@idpbridge.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deploy identity handoff: SAML/SCIM + role mapping readiness

Attached my updated id-mapping-table.csv with the two changes we discussed:
- Map ClearHealth group RH_SRE -> Redwood role: infra_admin (scoped to project:clearhealth).
- Add fallback mapping for any groups prefixed with RH_readonly -> observer role.

Notes:
- We will enforce SCIM attribute email as the primary key; if IdP sends a different identifier we can transform on ingest but prefer email consistency.
- For service accounts (non-human), we require an extra attribute: service=true. Those are provisioned via a separate SCIM namespace and mapped to the service_role.

I'll be online during the smoke window tomorrow — ping me in the shared channel and I can run a manual reconciliation if needed.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Staff Software Engineer, Identity — Redwood Inference
Attachments: id-mapping-table.csv (stub)

Subject: Re: Private deploy identity handoff: SAML/SCIM + role mapping readiness

Good news — smoke run completed successfully. Summary:
- SAML assertions accepted by staging control plane; persistent NameID worked as expected.
- SCIM create/update/delete actions processed; group mapping produced correct role assignments for the test cohort.
- Minor mismatch: one legacy group (legacy_eng) didn't namespace correctly and defaulted to observer — we'll fix the IdP mapping.

Thanks to the Redwood on-call folks (Marcus/Dev) and Anil for fast turnarounds. Next step: book production cutover slot; we'll coordinate the calendar once we've updated the IdP group naming (target: Nov 12).

Priya
Priya Rao
Security Lead, ClearHealth
